summary: This edition makes 12 reader-facing changes: 11 additions, 1 correction. No guidance was removed.

items.title: Test the cache boundary
items.whatChanged: Added a test that holds the prefix fixed, changes the suffix and checks actual cache reads and writes.
items.why: Shared tokens can still miss the cache when no eligible boundary captures the reusable prefix.

items.title: Measure KV retention and peak memory together
items.whatChanged: Added separate checks for retained state, physical allocation, full-invocation peak memory and long-context quality.
items.why: A smaller retained cache can leave the prefill peak unchanged or discard evidence the task still needs.

sources.title: HeadWiseKV: Budgeted Per-Head Cache Residency for Hybrid Long-Context Language Models

items.title: Track asynchronous tool jobs through completion
items.whatChanged: Added persistent job-to-call identity, separate pending status, and delivery of the eventual result against the original call.
items.why: A job can outlive the initiating turn; treating dispatch as completion or reusing a handle can attach a result to the wrong action.

items.title: Test omitted and explicit model settings
items.whatChanged: Added migration checks for effective reasoning, output budgets, tool/API support and cache controls, including omitted parameters.
items.why: An omitted setting can change behavior and cost; accepting the same request shape does not prove equivalent operation.

items.title: Separate traffic ramp limits from overload
items.whatChanged: Added provider-code classification and coordinated, deadline-bounded recovery for ramp throttling and capacity overload.
items.why: A status-only retry policy can miss the relevant error class or amplify pressure through independent worker retries.

items.title: Recalibrate monitors after model changes
items.whatChanged: Added channel-specific detection, false-alarm and evasion checks when the model or reasoning configuration changes.
items.why: Changes in reasoning traces can weaken an existing monitor even when task performance improves.

items.title: Validate both token-ID bounds
items.whatChanged: Added host-side integer and vocabulary-bound checks before accelerator work, with endpoint and concurrent-tenant regression tests.
items.why: A negative token ID can pass an upper-bound-only check and poison shared engine state.
